description: Create a new email campaign in the `draft` state; requires `name`, `domain_id`, `from_local_part`, and a `template_attributes.subject`.

contact_list_ids.description: IDs of contact lists to send to. Treated as the full set of included lists. Combine with `contact_segment_ids` to target both.

contact_segment_ids.description: IDs of contact segments to send to. Treated as the full set of included segments.

delivery_mode.description: How the campaign is delivered. `rapid` sends as fast as possible; `gradual` throttles sending to `delivery_options.emails_per_hour`.

delivery_options.description: Delivery throttling options. Applies when `delivery_mode` is `gradual`.

emails_per_hour.description: Maximum number of emails sent per hour.

domain_id.description: ID of the verified sending domain used for the campaign, as returned by the Sending Domains endpoints.

from_display_name.description: Display name shown in the From header.

from_local_part.description: Local part (before the @) of the From address.

local_part.description: Local part (before the @) of the Reply-To address.

template_attributes.description: Inline email template — the campaign's subject and design.

body_html.description: HTML body of the email (the design). Optional for a draft; required before the campaign can be scheduled or started. Include an unsubscribe link via an anchor whose `href` contains the `__unsubscribe_url__` placeholder. Supports `{{tag_name}}` merge tags.

body_text.description: Optional plain-text alternative of the email body. Supports the same `__unsubscribe_url__` placeholder and `{{tag_name}}` merge tags as `body_html`.

merge_tags.description: Bare names of the merge tags referenced in the subject/body, without the `{{ }}` delimiters — e.g. `["first_name"]`.

subject.description: Email subject line (max 255 chars). Required when creating a campaign. Supports merge tags, e.g. `Hi {{first_name}}`.

name: create-email-campaign
